remarks: Step into the heart of Norwalk's vibrant SoNo Wall Street district and discover your new home or your next smart investment. This stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner unit offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and urban convenience, making it ideal for young professionals seeking a dynamic lifestyle and investors looking for strong rental potential. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a private gym, central air, building elevator and covered parking. Start your day with sunlight streaming through your balcony and windows. The open-concept living area flows right into the updated kitchen with bar counter and ample cabinet space. The second bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a home office, or a roommate. Steps from trendy bars, restaurants, public transportation, parks, and the iconic SoNo Collection, offering endless entertainment and shopping options. Commuting is a breeze with easy access to Metro North and major highways.
